category_title: Verbal students with autism who discuss negative topics and use headsets to avoid interaction
minimal_context: Jordan is walking through the hallway between classes and practicing using his communication book to talk to a classmate.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jordan, it is time to transition to your next class. Let's use your communication book to talk to a classmate in the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks rapidly through the hallway listening to music on a headset, rarely smiling.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take off your headset and try to start a conversation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes off the headset and greets a peer) Hi. I got poor grades.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else can you say to them?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Appears angry) My family has problems. I’m gonna Taser that kid . . .

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Jordan, it is time to transition to your next class. Let's use your communication book to talk to a classmate in the hallway.

STUDENT: (Walks rapidly through the hallway listening to music on a headset, rarely smiling.)

TUTOR: Please take off your headset and try to start a conversation.

STUDENT: (Takes off the headset and greets a peer) Hi. I got poor grades.

TUTOR: What else can you say to them?

STUDENT: (Appears angry) My family has problems. I’m gonna Taser that kid . . .
